title: Test per-epoch advantage refresh and audit KL-stop frequency
doing: Propose frozen rollout GAE versus refreshing advantages and returns from the current critic before each PPO epoch. Preserve behavior actions/log-probabilities, refresh matching next-state values including pre-reset truncation and final observations, keep four-epoch maximum and0.03 full-rollout epoch-end KL stop unchanged. Log GAE moments by epoch, stop counts/denominators and actual epochs/steps. No training launch.
expected: Fresh advantages may improve updates if critic drift makes frozen targets stale, or add noise and inference cost with no Q1 gain. Actual KL-stop frequency can distinguish lost epochs from poor full-epoch learning; booleans without numerical KL cannot explain the warm-start regression.

evidence.label: User-directed literature checklist handoff; papers are priors, not Dodge results
